run_test_rendering: run the test script to render images and videos from a trained NeRF model checkpoint
run_main_with_checkpoint: run main to load a specific checkpoint and render test images and videos
render_test_images: render all images from train, val, and test datasets using the trained model
render_video_from_model: render a video from the trained NeRF model using render_video with a custom name
load_and_render_single_image: load model weights and render a single test image using create_sample_wrapper and render_img
